subject: Push RMarkdown generated html to htmlOutput

messages.author: 259feabe597de5ec
messages.subject: Push RMarkdown generated html to htmlOutput
parts:
Hello.

I've got a rather complicated shiny app that's fairly interactive. I would like to have a tab that, when activated by the user, generates a report of all the information the user has entered. Then I would like to display that information in the tab. I've tried to create a minimal example here to demonstrate what I'd like to do. I've got the Rmd file that generates output, and I've got the shiny app with widgets that do what I'm looking for. Now I'm struggling to figure out how to take the html that is generated when I click on the "Generate Report" tab and display the report content in that tab. Can anyone help me out here?

Thanks
John

messages.author: 259feabe597de5ec
messages.subject: Re: Push RMarkdown generated html to htmlOutput
parts:
I believe I solved my own problem. After I generated the html, I found i can use includeHTML

report = includeHTML('example_report.html')

and return that to the htmlOutput. If anyone has any better suggestions, I'd be happy to hear them.
